catalogue: Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th Revised Ed. (Hoffleit & Warren 1991), CDS V/50
frame: equatorial, J2000 equinox and epoch (right ascension and declination in degrees)
to_ecliptic_j2000: rotate about the x axis by the obliquity 23.4392911 degrees: x_ecl = x_eq, y_ecl = y_eq*cos(e) + z_eq*sin(e), z_ecl = -y_eq*sin(e) + z_eq*cos(e)

fields.designation: Bayer/Flamsteed designation from the catalogue, if any
fields.pm: proper motion [RA x cos(dec), Dec] in arcsec per Julian year (FK5, J2000)
fields.plx: trigonometric parallax in arcsec (left out when missing or only dynamical)
fields.rv: radial velocity in km/s (positive = receding), when a parallax is given
fields.name: IAU proper name (WGSN), given for the 50 brightest named stars plus Polaris and the stars of the Plough, Orion and Cassiopeia
